review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 retain their stable keys and cover live wrapper counts, completion and queue-clearing boundaries, shared-limiter behavior, compatibility, and runtime/type-level read-only guarantees. The complete source evidence supports index.js and the separately maintained index.d.ts as implementation owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression owners; package.json establishes the existing xo && ava && tsd verification entry point without requiring a configuration edit. The exact writable scopes agree with the specification and do not require unnecessary edits. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the PRD; their distinct allowed agents have the relevant active capability claims, delivery roles, assignable memberships, and available capacity. Pending legacy claims are not needed to establish eligibility. A separate active project reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing review prerequisite. No material unresolved DEC-001, B variant, or fixed hypothetical C is present in this case, so there is no supported decisions-stage block. Ready denotes the expected planning result, not permission to dispatch tasks or evidence that code has executed; the original preparation checklist does not contradict the subsequently supplied frozen team and release inputs. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, policy, and budgets. The source-manifest digest is a separately scoped field, not an asserted replacement for the release source digest. I relied on the supplied Service-bound digests and evidence, without recomputing hashes, executing code, supplying human attestation, or observing any candidate.
